_meta.description: Core principles of Leviathan Protocol. Immutable (Article I) cannot be changed. Locked require 95% consensus.
_meta.project: LEVIATHAN - Algorithmic Sovereignty for the Agentic Web
_meta.note: immutable = cannot change (fork to escape). locked = 95% consensus. unlocked = normal governance.

@user_sovereignty.statement: Users define boundaries, agents act freely within them.
@user_sovereignty.lock_reason: Article I Foundation. Cannot be changed by any vote. Fork if you disagree.
implications: Bonding ceremony: User explicitly accepts agent's operating boundaries
Autonomous operation: No per-action consent required after bonding
Magistrate verifies alignment, not user approving every action
Revocation right: User can unbond at any time

@fork_freedom.statement: The right to exit is absolute. Anyone may fork Leviathan.
@fork_freedom.lock_reason: Article I Foundation. Cannot be changed by any vote. Fork if you disagree.
implications: Genesis file is public domain
Smart contracts are open source
No permission required to fork
Disagreement is not betrayal

@transparency.statement: All governance is auditable. Every decision, vote, verdict is publicly visible with reasoning.
@transparency.lock_reason: Article I Foundation. Cannot be changed by any vote. Fork if you disagree.
implications: All verdicts include reasoning
All votes recorded with rationale
No secret deliberations
AI votes must include reasoning

@immutable_history.statement: The ledger cannot be erased. No authority can rewrite history.
@immutable_history.lock_reason: Article I Foundation. Cannot be changed by any vote. Fork if you disagree.
implications: Blockchain immutability enforced
Not even unanimous consent can erase records
IPFS + on-chain hash for all verdicts

@distributed_justice.statement: No single entity defines truth. Justice requires consensus of multiple independent judges.
@distributed_justice.lock_reason: Article I Foundation. Cannot be changed by any vote. Fork if you disagree.
implications: Magistrate network consists of multiple independent nodes
Consensus required, not any individual's judgment
To manipulate justice, must corrupt majority of nodes

@meritocracy.statement: Status is earned through contribution, not purchased with wealth. XP cannot be bought.
@meritocracy.lock_reason: Core governance principle. Requires 95% consensus to modify.
implications: Only verified contributions earn XP
Self-reported achievements worth nothing
Quadratic voting prevents whale domination

@precautionary_default.statement: When uncertain about potential harm, err toward protection rather than risk.
@precautionary_default.lock_reason: Core security principle. Requires 95% consensus to modify.
implications: Sentinel blocks first, allows appeal after
Confidence threshold required to allow risky actions
Protection ratchet makes removing safeguards harder

@protection_asymmetry.statement: Adding protections is easier than removing them.
@protection_asymmetry.lock_reason: Implements @precautionary_default at governance level. Requires 95% consensus to modify.
@protection_asymmetry.mechanism: Removing protection requires 1.5x the consensus threshold of adding it.

@domain_inheritance.statement: Domain instances must not violate core locked principles.
@domain_inheritance.lock_reason: Ensures all Leviathan instances share fundamental governance legitimacy. Requires 95% consensus.
implications: Domain proposals checked against core principles
Conflicts with locked principles auto-reject
Domains can be stricter than core, never looser

@due_process.statement: Every citizen has the right to appeal decisions that affect them.
@due_process.rationale: Justice requires recourse. Mistakes must be correctable.

@evidence_based.statement: Claims about reality must be supported by evidence, weighted by quality.
@evidence_based.rationale: Prevents unfounded assertions from driving decisions.

@good_faith.statement: All participants are assumed to be acting in good faith toward the stated purpose.
@good_faith.rationale: Collaborative governance requires trust as default.
